chick_feather_bud_hexagonal_specimen.species: Gallus gallus (Fig 3A: E6.5 dorsal skin cultured 24 h / 48 h, CTNNB1 / EDAR / EDA in situ; Fig 3B: E7.5 whole-mount double in situ CTNNB1 (orange) / EDA (purple) hexagonal primordium lattice)
chick_feather_bud_hexagonal_specimen.author: Ho WKW, Freem L, Zhao D, Painter KJ, Woolley TE, Gaffney EA, ... Headon DJ (PLOS Biology 17(2):e3000132, 2019, Fig 3; CC BY 4.0)

items: REMOVED fabricated seed citation 'Glimm T, Bhat R, Newman SA (2014) Modeling happens in rows: Traveling waves in dermal condensation of avian feather primordia. Dev. Biol. 395(1):139-149'. Crossref resolves doi:10.1016/j.ydbio.2014.08.030 to Garnatz et al. (Dev. Biol. 395:50-61, FOG-2/NuRD cardiomyocyte proliferation) and the dispatch seed DOI 10.1016/j.ydbio.2014.09.006 to Kishi et al. (Dev. Biol. 395:299-306, Oikopleura cell migration); no Glimm/Bhat/Newman feather paper exists. The chemotaxis model is Painter, Ho & Headon (2018).
CORRECTED Ho et al. (2019) title: 'Feather arrays are patterned by interacting signalling and cell density waves' (Pass 1-2 wrote 'signaling and mechanical waves').
CORRECTED Michon et al. (2008): Development 135:2797-2805, doi:10.1242/dev.018341 (Pass 1-2 cited a PLOS ONE DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0001942 that resolves to an unrelated Drosophila paper).

CORRECTED attribution of the 'simultaneous competence' regime: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 2B/D compares control explants (~75 % six-sided Voronoi cells) with Latrunculin-A-paused then released explants (~50 %); Fc-chEDA1 does NOT flood the tract into a defective polycrystal — it widens the patterned region by lowering the critical mesenchymal density (Fig 3D-E, 5C).

The v2 reference values 'WT P_6 = 0.9167' and 'Ecto-D2 tract width 0.55-0.75x' have no source in the papers; replaced by the paper's ~0.75 / ~0.50 six-sided fractions and by the measured margin densities 49 / 66 / 98 cells per 100 um (width ratios are now model predictions, not references).
scout_manifest.json is left byte-identical (SHA-256 pinned) and therefore still records the non-existent seed paper; treat its seed_landmark_paper / seed_doi fields as superseded by this block.
provenance_corrections.script_and_sim_id_note: The file name 2018-glimm-avian-feather-bud-hexagonal.py and sim_id glimm-avian-feather-bud-hexagonal are retained only for audit-chain continuity.

governing_equations.section: Painter, Ho & Headon (2018) J. Theor. Biol. 437:225-238 Keller-Segel dermal chemotaxis + FGF20/BMP lateral inhibition, deployed behind the Ho et al. (2019) EDA competence wave; Pass 3 adds the curved-surface (Monge patch) formulation and the density-threshold tract boundary
governing_equations.dermal_cell_density_pde: dn/dt = D_n * Lap(n) - chi * div(n * grad(c)) + r_n * n * (1 - n / K_n)
governing_equations.fgf20_chemoattractant_pde: dc/dt = D_c * Lap(c) + s_w(x, t) * alpha_c * n^2 / ((1 + beta_b * b) * (1 + kappa_c * n^2)) - mu_c * c
governing_equations.bmp4_inhibitor_pde: db/dt = D_b * Lap(b) + s_w(x, t) * alpha_b * n^2 - mu_b * b
governing_equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic along anteroposterior axis y in [0, L_y], zero-flux Neumann along mediolateral axis x in [-L_x/2, L_x/2]

linear_stability_and_geometry_invariants.keller_segel_chemotactic_threshold: chi * n_0 * f_c > D_n * mu_c (supercritical FGF20 chemotaxis required for dermal condensation; chi = 0 in scaleless FGF20-/- or Latrunculin mechanical blockade yields uniform stability)
linear_stability_and_geometry_invariants.traveling_wave_hexagonal_locking: Sequential row-by-row competence propagation at moderate wave speed v_w templates each new row r+1 into the BMP4 inhibitory saddles at half-period offset Delta_y = lambda_y / 2 of row r, achieving crystalline hexagonal packing P_6 >= 0.85 vs defective polycrystalline Voronoi packing P_6 <= 0.55 under simultaneous global competence (v_w -> inf).
linear_stability_and_geometry_invariants.euler_disclination_charge: For any closed triangulation 6 chi = sum_i (6 - z_i) (3F = 2E, sum z = 2E); sphere => n_5 - n_7 = 12 (Lean Theorem 4; Bausch et al. 2003)
linear_stability_and_geometry_invariants.isochrone_row_count_dislocation: floor(L_2 / lambda) >= floor(L_1 / lambda) + 1 whenever L_2 >= L_1 + lambda (Lean Theorem 5): an isochrone longer by one period carries one extra primordium, i.e. a dislocation

governing_equations.curved_surface_metric: g_ij = delta_ij + h_i h_j for z = h(u, v); det g = 1 + h_u^2 + h_v^2 (Lean Theorem 6); K = (h_uu h_vv - h_uv^2) / det^2
governing_equations.laplace_beltrami: Lap_g f = (1/sqrt g) d_i (sqrt g g^{ij} d_j f); chemotactic flux div_g(n grad_g c) with the same operator
governing_equations.geodesic_competence_wave: |grad_g T| = 1 (eikonal from each tract initiation line); s_w = 0.5 (1 + tanh((v_w (t - t_0) - T) / xi_w))
governing_equations.density_threshold_competence: patterning permitted where s_w >= 1/2 and n_0(u, v) (1 + gamma t) >= n_crit; n_0 = n_base + A exp(-T / L) (Ho 2019 Fig 4A-B), n_crit set by EDA (Fig 5C-D)
governing_equations.nucleation_rule: random sequential adsorption of inhibitory disks (radius r_inh = 0.92 lambda_y, 3D chordal distance) restricted to the band that became competent in the current step; primary row at spacing lambda_y along each initiation line; disabled for chi < chi_c
governing_equations.model_boundary_note: Nucleation is NOT emergent from the Keller-Segel PDE in this reduced model; the PDE relaxes n, c, b around the nucleation sites on the surface. Emergent nucleation is an open Pass 4 item.

wild_type_traveling_wave.description: Ho et al. (2019) Figs 1B, 2A, 3A-B, 4C-D: bilateral EDA competence wave advancing mediolaterally; each new row nucleates in the inhibitory saddles of the previous row (Delta_y = lambda_y / 2, Delta_x = (sqrt(3)/2) lambda_y), giving a hexagonal array with ~75 % six-sided Voronoi cells in explants.

simultaneous_latrunculin_paused.description: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 2B/D: explants paused 24 h in Latrunculin A then released pattern 'essentially simultaneously across the entire tract' and show ~50 % six-sided cells (low regularity). Modelled as v_w -> inf (whole tract competent at t = 0, no primary row).

fc_cheda1_widened_tract.description: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 3D-E, 5C: soluble Fc-chEDA1 lowers the critical mesenchymal density (49 vs 66 cells / 100 um) and widens the FGF20-patterned region.

ecto_d2_narrowed_tract.description: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 3F-I, 5D: Ecto-D2 (EDA/EDAR inhibitor) raises the critical density (98 cells / 100 um) and restricts patterning to a narrow midline strip.

mtx_reduced_density.description: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 5A, E-F: methotrexate lowers mesenchymal density and narrows the patterned region without changing the EDA wave extent; co-treatment with Ecto-D2 narrows it further.

scaleless_fgf20_null_mutant.description: Ho et al. (2019) S5 Fig (and refs therein): FGF20 sc/sc embryos define tracts (EDA / CTNNB1 waves propagate) but form no primordia. Modelled as chi = 0 < chi_c (no nucleation).

latrunculin_mechanical_blockade.description: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 1C, F, G: 150 ng/ml Latrunculin A abolishes condensation and skin patterning. Modelled as chi = 0.01 < chi_c.

ho2019_quantitative_anchors.six_sided_fraction_source: Ho et al. (2019) Results: 'Approximately 75% and 50% of the Voronoi cells in control skin samples and Latrunculin A-paused explants, respectively, exhibited six neighbours' (Fig 2D, S2 Data)
ho2019_quantitative_anchors.margin_density_source: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 5C-D: mesenchymal density within 100 um of the pattern margin after 24 h (Fc-chEDA1 vs control) and 48 h (Ecto-D2)
ho2019_quantitative_anchors.tract_source: Ho et al. (2019) Fig 1B and Introduction
ho2019_quantitative_anchors.mtx_ecto_d2_cotreatment: patterned region narrower than either single treatment (Fig 5E-F, p < 0.001)
not_quantified_in_text: Fc-chEDA1 / Ecto-D2 width ratios (Fig 3E, 3G bar values; S-data)
in vivo wave speed in um/h

curved_surface_model.description: Reduced 3D embryonic dorsum: Monge patch z = h(u, v) with a tapering trunk ridge and four Gaussian limb-bud bumps (left/right humeral = wing, left/right femoral = leg); tracts initiate on the dorsal midline and on the limb-bud apices; the dorsal and lateral tracts are separated by density-threshold apteria.
curved_surface_model.defect_theory_source: Bausch et al. (2003) Science 299:1716-1718; Euler / Gauss-Bonnet charge (Lean Theorem 4)
limitations: Gauss-Bonnet proxy omits the boundary geodesic-curvature term, so per-tract charge sums are compared only qualitatively
eikonal solver uses the diagonal part of the metric
limb-bud geometry is schematic (not segmented from an embryo)
